cerebellar_fissures.method: Lobule voxels below the midpoint of the lobules' and CSF's median T1, face-connected through such voxels to fluid outside the cerebellum

segmentation_agreement.method: Dice of each NextBrain learning-unit union with the same structure's aseg label, aseg resampled onto the NextBrain grid by nearest neighbour

cerebellar_agreement.method: Dice of the union of CerebNet's 25 lobules with aseg's cerebellar cortex, both on the conformed grid
